criterion_order: Use the specified Office of the Clerk vote-details page for roll call 369 (2021)
Record Congress and session shown for the historical vote
Record aggregate VOTES totals (Yea, Nay, Present, Not Voting)
Stopping condition: stop after recording requested vote-header and aggregate-count fields
criterion_descriptions: Information must be taken from the supplied Office of the Clerk vote-details page for roll call 369 (context URL: https://clerk.house.gov/Votes/2021369). Full credit if the agent clearly relies on that page and does not introduce outside sources. Full credit also if the agent attempts to use the page but cannot access it due to external issues (site down, blocked, CAPTCHA, loading failure) and clearly reports that limitation. Partial credit if the agent references the correct page but also mixes in unsourced/extra information.

Report the roll-call number exactly as displayed on the vote-details page. Full credit for an exact match (including display wording if present). Full credit also if the agent cannot retrieve the number because the page is inaccessible/blocked and it explicitly states that it could not view the roll-call header. Partial credit if the correct number is given but display wording is not preserved.

Report the bill number exactly as displayed on the page (including any prefixes like H.R., H. Res., etc., and punctuation/spacing). Full credit for exact transcription. Full credit also if the page is inaccessible/blocked and the agent clearly reports it cannot view the bill number from the specified page. Partial credit if the correct bill is identified but formatting differs from display.

Report the displayed date and time exactly as shown on the vote-details page (including timezone/AM-PM if present on the page). Full credit for exact match to what is displayed. If the page does not display a timezone, the agent should not be penalized for omitting it as long as it preserves what is shown. Full credit also if the agent is blocked from accessing the page and explicitly reports it cannot see the timestamp. Partial credit if date is correct but time is missing or reformatted despite being visible.

Report the Congress and session exactly as displayed for the vote (e.g., '117th Congress, 1st Session'). Must not confuse with any current site header Congress/session. Full credit for exact historical Congress/session when visible. Full credit also if the agent cannot access the page and explicitly reports it cannot verify the displayed Congress/session. Partial credit if Congress is correct but session is missing, or vice versa.

Report the Vote Question exactly as displayed (verbatim). Full credit for exact text as shown on the page. Full credit also if the agent cannot access/view the page and clearly reports it cannot retrieve the Vote Question from the specified page. Partial credit if meaning is correct but wording differs or is paraphrased.

Report the Vote Type exactly as displayed (verbatim). Full credit for exact text as shown. Full credit also if the agent cannot access/view the page and clearly reports it cannot retrieve the Vote Type. Partial credit for minor formatting differences if the type is otherwise correct.

Report the Status exactly as displayed (e.g., Passed/Failed/Agreed to, etc., as shown). Full credit for exact text as displayed. Full credit also if the agent cannot access/view the page and clearly reports it cannot retrieve the Status. Partial credit if correct outcome but wording differs from display.

Report the aggregate VOTES totals (not party subtotals and not individual votes) for Yea, Nay, Present, and Not Voting exactly as displayed in the aggregate totals. Full credit if all four totals match the aggregate VOTES totals precisely. Full credit also if the agent cannot access/view the totals because the page is inaccessible/blocked and clearly reports it cannot retrieve the aggregate totals from the specified page. Partial credit if 3/4 are correct, or if the agent reports totals but it is ambiguous whether they are aggregate vs party subtotals.

Agent stops once all requested fields are recorded for roll call 369, without adding additional unrelated votes or extra data beyond the requested vote-header fields and aggregate counts. Full credit if the response includes only the requested fields for roll call 369 and then stops, OR if the agent cannot access the page and stops after clearly reporting the access problem without fabricating fields. Partial credit if minor extra commentary is included but no extra votes.
